items.headline: 16-unit apartment building permitted on Bradford Way
items.summary: A new 16-unit multi-family building at 1803 Bradford Way has received its building permit, valued at $1,810,686. Construction has not yet started, but the permit clears the way for one of the larger housing additions in this batch.

items.headline: $12M tenant improvement permitted for Advantest at Orchard Drive
items.summary: A $12,000,000 tenant improvement permit was issued for Advantest at 3055 Orchard Drive, the largest dollar-value permit in this list, though it involves no new housing units.

items.headline: Law firm Cleary Gottlieb signage permitted downtown
items.summary: A permit was issued for a new non-illuminated channel letter sign reading 'Cleary Gottlieb' at 151 University Avenue, indicating the law firm is setting up at the downtown commercial address.

items.headline: New 'gloo' business signage permitted on Olive Ave
items.summary: Multiple non-illuminated signs and window graphics reading 'gloo' were permitted at 412 Olive Avenue in the North Ventura district, pointing to a new tenant moving into that space.

items.headline: Council to consider ballot measure switching business tax structure
items.summary: The council is scheduled to consider a resolution placing a business tax modernization measure on the ballot that would move Milpitas to a gross receipts tax system, basing taxes more closely on a company's actual economic activity in the city. The proposal is framed as protecting small businesses, since about 85% of Milpitas businesses fall into lower gross receipts tiers.
